G_over_GDP.construction: general-government final consumption / GDP, current prices, mean 1999-2010 (window recovered: the original was not recorded)

import_share_EL_2012.construction: Greek imports of goods and services, 2012; no national-accounts ratio gives 32%

real_deposit_rate_1999_2007.construction: euro-area three-month Euribor minus HICP inflation (yoy), monthly mean, % a year

bond_hazard_1999_2007.construction: mean GR-DE ten-year spread 1999-2007 as a quarterly hazard at LGD 0.55, %

liquid_deposits_over_gdp_EL.construction: households' and NPISHs' currency and deposits (F2) / GDP, 2008

greek_bank_assets_over_gdp.construction: total assets of the six Greek EBA banks / Greek GDP, 2010

eba_held_greek_debt_over_gdp.construction: Greek sovereign held by the EBA sample / Greek GDP, 2010

debt_over_gdp_2012.construction: general-government gross debt, % of GDP, 2012 (current vintage)

greek_primary_surplus_2016_2018.construction: IMF DataMapper primary balance, % of GDP

default_probability_2010_2011.construction: Greek one-year CDS, 2010Q1-2011Q4, Bocola's conversion at LGD 0.55, % a quarter (from greek_cds/greek.py)
